content: आश्विन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) .²1 Belonging or sacred to the Aśvins (अश्विनौ देवते अस्य). .²2 Pervading. .{@-नः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a month (in which the moon is near the constellation Aśvini). .²2 A sacrifice or a weapon presided over by the Aśvins. .²3 (<ab>du.</ab>) The Aśvins. .{@-नी@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of certain bricks. .²2 A pile, stack (चितिभेदः). .{@-नम्@} A dayʼs journey for a horse or rider (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .{@-चिह्नितम्@} The autumnal equinox.
